description.narrative:
The planned main product/s and/or service/s of the Activity (Outputs) is:
- Providing scholarship funding to 37 activists, advocates, CSO leaders, and gender champions from ODA-funded low- and middle-income countries to attend the Women Deliver Conference in Kigali, Rwanda from July 17 – 21, 2023. Scholarship funds include registration, travel to and from Kigali, accommodation, and a modest stipend at WD2023.
The expected effect/s for the target group of the Activity (Outcome) is/are:
- Taking place in Kigali, Rwanda from July 17-20, with 6,000+ registered attendees on-site and 200,000 participants online, WD2023 will connect with other key policy moments, center the key issues of our time, and promote a robust civic space for feminist action, organizing, and mobilization. WD2023 will serve as an important civil society-driven accountability mechanism following several commitments that have been made around gender equality at international fora, including the Nairobi Summit, Generation Equality Forum (GEF), the G7 Summit, and the United Nations Climate Change Summit (COP26). The Conference will also provide a platform for early momentum for the UN’s Our Common Agenda and Summit for the Future. WD2023 is well-positioned to help ensure that commitments made result in gender-transformative policy change. - Strengthening girls’ and women’s rights, participation, and position in society, primarily through ensuring that women and girls participate on an equal footing with men in political life and have equal political rights.
